source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 20 (PDF 156-168), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 20 (Medical Physics) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define radiation and classify it into ionizing and non-ionizing radiation. Give the examples used in medical physics, state how each kind interacts with matter, and describe the medical uses of gamma rays, X-rays, ultrasonic waves and radiowaves. (5 marks)
(Radiation ki definition likh kar use ionizing aur non-ionizing mein taqseem karein. Medical physics wali misalein dein, har qisam ka maadde se interaction batayein, aur gamma rays, X-rays, ultrasonic waves aur radiowaves ke tibbi istemaal bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Radiation: khala ya maadde mein waves ya particles ki shakal mein energy ki muntaqili. Medical physics mein yeh zyada tar tashkhees (imaging) aur ilaaj ke liye hai.

Taqseem:
(i) Ionizing radiation itni energy rakhti hai ke atoms se electrons nikaal kar ions banaye. Misalein: X-rays, gamma rays aur positrons. X-rays aur gamma rays photoelectric effect aur Compton scattering se interact karti hain; positrons radioactive tracers se nikalte hain.
(ii) Non-ionizing radiation mein atoms se electrons nikalne jitni energy nahin. Misalein: ultrasound waves aur radiowaves. Yeh maadde se reflect, refract ya absorb hoti hain.

Tibbi istemaal:
• X-rays: haddiyon aur andarooni aaza ki tasweer.
• Gamma rays: nuclear medicine (PET scans) aur cancer ka ilaaj, zyada penetrating power ki wajah se.
• Ultrasonic waves: naram tissues, fetus aur andarooni aaza ki mehfooz imaging, baghair ionizing radiation ke.
• Radiowaves: MRI mein atomic nuclei se interact kar ke tafseeli tasaveer, khaas taur par naram tissues, baghair nuqsandeh radiation ke.

book_ref.quote: In medical physics, radiation is mainly used for diagnosis (imaging) and treatment.

blocks.prompt:
2 Compare the energy of one photon of X-rays of wavelength 2.0 × 10⁻¹¹ m with that of one photon of the 64 MHz radiowaves used in an MRI scanner. Express both in joules and electronvolts and find their ratio (h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, 1 eV = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ J). (3 marks)
(2.0 × 10⁻¹¹ m wavelength wali X-rays ke aik photon ki energy ka muqabla MRI scanner ki 64 MHz radiowaves ke aik photon se karein. Dono joules aur electronvolts mein likhein aur un ki nisbat maloom karein (h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, 1 eV = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ J).)
blocks.explanation: X-ray ke liye E = hc/λ aur radiowave ke liye E = hf; bara farq batata hai ke aik ionize karti hai aur doosri nahin.

book_ref.quote: Non-ionizing radiation does not have enough energy to remove electrons from atoms.

blocks.final_answer: X-ray photon ≈ 9.95 × 10⁻¹⁵ J (62 keV); radiowave photon ≈ 4.24 × 10⁻²⁶ J (2.65 × 10⁻⁷ eV); X-ray photon taqreeban 2.3 × 10¹¹ guna zyada energy rakhta hai, isi liye X-rays ionizing aur radiowaves non-ionizing hain.

blocks.prompt:
3 What is the piezoelectric effect? Give the origin of the name and its discovery, explain the effect in terms of the internal structure of the crystal, distinguish the direct and converse effects, and explain how this effect lets an ultrasound transducer play a dual role. (5 marks)
(Piezoelectric effect kya hai? Naam ki asal aur daryaft batayein, crystal ki andarooni banawat se effect samjhayein, direct aur converse effect mein farq karein, aur batayein yeh effect ultrasound transducer ko dohra kirdar kaise deta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Naam aur daryaft: "piezoelectric" Yunani "piezein" (dabana) aur "electric" (bijli paida hona) se bana. Yeh effect 1880 mein Pierre Curie aur Jacques Curie ne daryaft kiya; unhon ne dekha ke quartz, tourmaline aur Rochelle salt (sodium potassium tartrate) jaise crystals par mechanical dabao se electric charge paida hota hai.

Wazahat: yeh effect kuch crystals ki khaas andarooni banawat ki wajah se hai. In crystals mein centre of symmetry nahin hota aur in ke andar positive aur negative charge ke chhote hisse hote hain. Aam taur par yeh barabar hote hain. Dabao se tawazun bigarta hai, charges thora hilte hain aur surface par electric field aa jati hai (Fig. 20.1, lead zirconate titanate, PZT ka crystal).

Do qisamein:
(i) Direct piezoelectric effect: crystal par mechanical dabao se us ki surface par electric field (voltage) paida hoti hai.
(ii) Converse piezoelectric effect: crystal par electric field lagane se us ki shakal thori badal jati hai.
Yaani yeh effect dabao ko voltage mein aur voltage ko dabao mein badalta hai.

Ultrasound transducer: ultrasound imaging isi effect par chalti hai. Transducer ka dohra kirdar hai: yeh ultrasound waves paida karta hai (voltage lagne par crystal ki shakal badalti hai) aur phir receive mode mein reflected echoes detect karta hai, jo crystal ko dabate hain aur direct piezoelectric effect se electrical signals ban jate hain.

book_ref.quote: The piezoelectric effect is possible because of the unique internal structure of some crystals.

blocks.prompt:
4 A piezoelectric transducer produces ultrasound of frequency 4.0 MHz. Using v = fλ, find the wavelength of this ultrasound (i) in soft tissue, where sound travels at 1540 m s⁻¹ (ii) in bone, where it travels at 4080 m s⁻¹. (3 marks)
(Piezoelectric transducer 4.0 MHz frequency ka ultrasound paida karta hai. v = fλ se is ki wavelength maloom karein (i) naram tissue mein jahan awaaz 1540 m s⁻¹ se chalti hai (ii) haddi mein jahan 4080 m s⁻¹ se chalti hai.)
blocks.explanation: Frequency hilte crystal se tay hai; wavelength har tissue ki raftaar se badalti hai: λ = v/f.

book_ref.quote: On the other hand, if we apply an electric field to the crystal, it changes shape a little.

blocks.final_answer: (i) naram tissue mein 0.385 mm (ii) haddi mein 1.02 mm.

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe the physical principles on which diagnostic ultrasound imaging works, from the emission of a pulse to the formation of the image. Why is ultrasound considered a safe and repeatable method? (5 marks)
(Tashkheesi ultrasound imaging kin physical usoolon par kaam karti hai, pulse ke nikalne se tasweer banne tak bayan karein. Ultrasound ko mehfooz aur bar bar kiya jane wala tareeqa kyun samjha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Ultrasound se doctors jism ki andarooni banawat foran (real time) dekhte hain (ultrasound machine, Fig. 20.2). Is ka kaam in usoolon par hai:

(i) Ikhraj: piezoelectric transducer oonchi frequency (aam taur par 1 MHz-15 MHz) ki awaaz ki pulses jism mein bhejta hai.
(ii) Safar: waves tissue ki qisam ke mutabiq mukhtalif raftaar se chalti hain.
(iii) Reflection: jab waves mukhtalif acoustic impedance (tissue ki density aur awaaz ki raftaar se tay) wale do tissues ki sarhad par pahunchti hain to kuch hissa echo ban kar reflect hota hai.
(iv) Detection: transducer receive mode mein ja kar direct piezoelectric effect se reflected waves detect karta hai; echoes electrical signals ban kar machine mein process hote hain.
(v) Tasweer: computer wapas aane wale echoes ki der (time delay) aur intensity ka hisaab laga kar tasweer banata hai. Zyada taaqatwar reflection wale hisse roshan dikhte hain.

Hifazat: ultrasound ionizing radiation istemaal nahin karta, is liye mehfooz, non-invasive aur bar bar qabil-e-istemaal hai.

book_ref.quote: The functioning of ultrasound imaging is based on several physical principles.

blocks.prompt:
6 An ultrasound pulse is sent into the abdomen. Echoes from the front and back walls of an organ return after 65 μs and 91 μs. Taking the speed of sound in tissue as 1540 m s⁻¹, find (i) the depth of the front wall (ii) the depth of the back wall (iii) the thickness of the organ. (3 marks)
(Pet mein ultrasound pulse bheji jati hai. Organ ki agli aur pichhli deewar se echoes 65 μs aur 91 μs baad wapas aate hain. Tissue mein awaaz ki raftaar 1540 m s⁻¹ le kar maloom karein (i) agli deewar ki gehrai (ii) pichhli deewar ki gehrai (iii) organ ki motai.)
blocks.explanation: Napa gaya waqt sarhad tak jaane aur wapas aane ka hai, is liye gehrai = vt/2.

book_ref.quote: Finally, a computer calculates the time delay and intensity of the returning echoes to construct a visual image.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Echo ka waqt jaane aur aane dono ka hota hai; is liye vt ko 2 se taqseem karte hain, warna gehrai dugni aa jayegi.

blocks.prompt:
7 Explain the factors that affect the quality of an ultrasound image. Also describe the uses of ultrasound in obstetrics, the abdomen, cardiology, urology and the musculoskeletal system. (5 marks)
(Ultrasound image ke mayaar par asar dalne wale awamil samjhayein. Obstetrics, pet, cardiology, urology aur musculoskeletal system mein ultrasound ke istemaal bhi bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tasweer ke mayaar ke awamil:
(i) Acoustic impedance ka farq: do tissues (maslan naram tissue aur haddi) mein zyada farq zyada taaqatwar echoes aur saaf sarhaden deta hai.
(ii) Ultrasound ki frequency: zyada frequency behtar resolution magar kam penetration; kam frequency zyada gehrai magar kam saaf tasweer.
(iii) Gel ka istemaal: transducer aur jild ke darmiyan khaas gel hawa ke khala khatam kar ke awaaz ki muntaqili behtar karti hai.
Ultrasound Doppler effect se, frequency ki tabdeeli pakar kar, khoon ke bahao ki raftaar bhi naap sakta hai.

Istemaal:
• Obstetrics: fetus ki nashonuma, hamal ki umar ka andaza aur kharabiyon ki pehchan.
• Pet: liver, kidneys, gallbladder, pancreas aur bladder ka muaina.
• Cardiology: echocardiography se dil ki banawat aur kaam ka foran jaiza.
• Urology: prostate, testicles aur urinary system ka muaina.
• Musculoskeletal system: ligament ki chot, joron ki sozish aur doosre naram tissue ke masail.

book_ref.quote: Acoustic Impedance Difference: A higher difference between two tissues

blocks.prompt:
8 A clinic has probes of 2.0 MHz and 12 MHz. Taking the speed of sound in tissue as 1540 m s⁻¹, find (i) the wavelength of each in tissue (ii) the ratio of the two wavelengths. State which probe suits a deep organ and which gives finer detail near the surface. (3 marks)
(Clinic mein 2.0 MHz aur 12 MHz ke probes hain. Tissue mein awaaz ki raftaar 1540 m s⁻¹ le kar maloom karein (i) tissue mein har aik ki wavelength (ii) dono wavelengths ki nisbat. Batayein kaun sa probe gehre organ ke liye aur kaun sa satah ke qareeb bareek tafseel ke liye munasib hai.)
blocks.explanation: λ = v/f; zyada frequency yaani chhoti wavelength, behtar resolution aur kam penetration.

book_ref.quote: lower frequency waves penetrate deeper but have lower image clarity

steps: Kam frequency (2.0 MHz) zyada gehrai tak jati hai; zyada frequency (12 MHz) behtar resolution magar kam penetration deti hai
blocks.final_answer: (i) 0.77 mm aur 0.128 mm (ii) 6.0; gehre organ ke liye 2.0 MHz aur satah ke qareeb bareek tafseel ke liye 12 MHz.

blocks.prompt:
9 Explain why electron transitions in light elements give infrared, visible or ultraviolet lines while inner-shell transitions in heavy atoms give X-rays. What are characteristic X-rays and why has their study been important? (5 marks)
(Samjhayein ke halke elements mein electron transitions infrared, visible ya ultraviolet lines kyun deti hain jabke bhaari atoms mein andarooni shell transitions X-rays. Characteristic X-rays kya hain aur in ka mutala kyun ahem raha hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Halke elements: hydrogen ya doosre halke elements mein electron transitions infrared, visible ya ultraviolet region mein lines deti hain, kyunke levels ke darmiyan energy ka farq chhota hai.

Bhaari atoms: electrons hum-markaz shells K, L, M, N, O waghera mein maane jate hain; K-shell nucleus ke sab se qareeb, phir L-shell (Fig. 20.3). Andarooni electrons mazbooti se bandhe hain aur unhein apni jagah se hatane ke liye bohat energy chahiye. Is excitation ke baad jab atom apni aam halat mein lautta hai to zyada energy ke photons nikalte hain. Yaani bhaari atoms mein andarooni shell transitions zyada energy ke photons yaani X-rays deti hain (Fig. 20.4).

Characteristic X-rays: yeh makhsoos wavelengths ya frequencies ki series hain, is liye characteristic X-rays kehlati hain; in ki energy target element par munhasir hai.

Ahmiyat: characteristic X-ray spectra ke mutale ne atom ki banawat aur elements ke periodic table ke mutale mein bohat ahem kirdar ada kiya.

book_ref.quote: In heavy atoms, the electrons are assumed to be arranged in concentric shells

blocks.prompt:
10 A transition in a light atom emits a photon of 1.9 eV, while an inner-shell transition in a heavy atom emits a photon of 8.0 keV. Find the wavelength of each photon and the ratio of their energies (h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, 1 eV = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ J). (3 marks)
(Halke atom ki transition 1.9 eV ka photon deti hai jabke bhaari atom ki andarooni shell transition 8.0 keV ka. Har photon ki wavelength aur un ki energies ki nisbat maloom karein (h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, 1 eV = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ J).)
blocks.explanation: Har energy ko joules mein badal kar λ = hc/E lagayein; zyada energy bohat chhoti wavelength deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus transition of inner shell electrons in heavy atoms gives rise to the emission of high energy photons or X-rays.

blocks.final_answer: 654 nm (visible roshni) aur 1.55 × 10⁻¹⁰ m (X-ray); X-ray photon ki energy taqreeban 4.2 × 10³ guna zyada hai.

blocks.prompt:
11 Describe the production of X-rays in an X-ray tube and obtain the maximum kinetic energy of the electrons striking the target. Explain how Kα and Kβ X-rays are produced, write their energy equations, and explain why they are called characteristic X-rays. (5 marks)
(X-ray tube mein X-rays ki paidaish bayan karein aur target se takrane wale electrons ki zyada se zyada kinetic energy hasil karein. Kα aur Kβ X-rays kaise banti hain, un ki energy ki equations likhein, aur batayein inhein characteristic X-rays kyun kehte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
X-ray tube (Fig. 20.5): high vacuum tube. Cathode C filament F se garam ho kar electrons kharij karta hai jo C aur T ke darmiyan potential difference V se anode (target) T ki taraf tez hote hain.

Zyada se zyada kinetic energy: charge e wala electron potential difference V se guzar kar Ve energy hasil karta hai, is liye target se takrane ki zyada se zyada kinetic energy
(K.E.)max = Ve ... (20.1)

Kα X-rays: Ve energy wale tez electrons tungsten ya kisi bhaari element ke target se takrate hain. Takkar mein K ya L jaise andarooni shell ka electron nikal sakta hai. Farz karein K-shell ka electron nikal jaye aur K-shell mein khali jagah (hole) ban jaye. L-shell ka electron is mein aata hai aur hf energy ka photon, yaani Kα X-ray, kharij karta hai:
hf(Kα) = E_L − E_K ... (20.2)

Kβ X-rays: M-shell ka electron bhi K-shell ke hole mein aa sakta hai. Is M → K transition ke photons Kβ X-rays hain:
hf(Kβ) = E_M − E_K ... (20.3)
Mazeed ooper ke shells se transitions aur K lines deti hain. L aur M shells mein bane holes ooper ke states ke electrons bharte hain aur mazeed X-rays banti hain.

Characteristic X-rays: andarooni shell transitions ke photons characteristic X-rays kehlate hain kyunke un ki energies target material ki qisam par munhasir hain. Yeh continuous spectrum par alag lines ki tarah nazar aate hain (Fig. 20.6).

book_ref.quote: Fig. 20.5 shows an arrangement of producing X-rays.

blocks.prompt:
12 In a heavy target atom the energy levels are E_K = −69.5 keV, E_L = −11.0 keV and E_M = −2.5 keV. Find the energy (in joules) and the wavelength of (i) the Kα photon (ii) the Kβ photon (h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, 1 eV = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ J). (3 marks)
(Aik bhaari target atom ke energy levels E_K = −69.5 keV, E_L = −11.0 keV aur E_M = −2.5 keV hain. (i) Kα photon (ii) Kβ photon ki energy (joules mein) aur wavelength maloom karein (h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, 1 eV = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ J).)
blocks.explanation: hf(Kα) = E_L − E_K aur hf(Kβ) = E_M − E_K lagayein, keV ko joules mein badlein, phir λ = hc/E.

book_ref.quote: The electron from the L-shell jumps to occupy the hole in the K-shell

blocks.final_answer: (i) Kα: 9.36 × 10⁻¹⁵ J, 2.13 × 10⁻¹¹ m (ii) Kβ: 1.07 × 10⁻¹⁴ J, 1.86 × 10⁻¹¹ m; Kβ ki energy zyada aur wavelength chhoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
13 Explain the origin of the continuous X-ray spectrum (bremsstrahlung). Why does it lie in the X-ray region? Show that the spectrum has a minimum wavelength and obtain its value in terms of the accelerating potential difference V. (5 marks)
(Continuous X-ray spectrum (bremsstrahlung) ki asal samjhayein. Yeh X-ray region mein kyun hai? Dikhayein ke spectrum ki aik kam se kam wavelength hai aur accelerating potential difference V ke hawale se us ki qeemat hasil karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Asal: continuous spectrum bremsstrahlung yaani braking radiation ki wajah se hai. Tez electrons target se takra kar achanak dheemay ho jate hain. Accelerated charge electromagnetic radiation kharij karta hai, is liye target se tezi se rukne wale electrons radiation dete hain.

X-ray region: rukne ki sharah bohat zyada hai, is liye radiation ki wavelength chhoti hai aur bremsstrahlung X-ray region mein hai.

Kam se kam wavelength: V se tez kiya gaya electron (K.E.)max = Ve se takrata hai. Agar electron pehli takkar mein saari kinetic energy kho de to woh poori energy sab se zyada frequency f_max ke aik X-ray photon mein aa jati hai:
(K.E.)max = hf_max, yaani Ve = hf_max
c = fλ se sab se zyada frequency sab se chhoti wavelength λmin ke barabar hai (Fig. 20.6):
Ve = hc/λmin, is liye λmin = hc/(Ve)
Koi photon Ve se zyada energy nahin rakh sakta, is liye λmin se chhoti wavelength nahin nikalti.

Baqi spectrum: doosre electrons pehli takkar mein saari energy nahin khote; rukne se pehle kai takkaren khate hain aur kam energy yaani lambi wavelength ki X-rays dete hain. Yun target se takrane wale electrons ke rukne se continuous spectrum banta hai, jis ke ooper characteristic lines hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: When the fast moving electrons bombard the target, they are suddenly slowed down on impact with the target.

blocks.prompt:
14 An X-ray tube is operated at 35 kV. Find (i) the maximum kinetic energy of the electrons striking the target (ii) the maximum frequency (iii) the minimum wavelength of the X-rays produced (h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, e = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C). (3 marks)
(X-ray tube 35 kV par chalai jati hai. Maloom karein (i) target se takrane wale electrons ki zyada se zyada kinetic energy (ii) zyada se zyada frequency (iii) paida hone wali X-rays ki kam se kam wavelength (h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, e = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C).)
blocks.explanation: Jo electron apni saari energy Ve aik photon ko de woh f_max aur λmin deta hai: Ve = hf_max = hc/λmin.

book_ref.quote: the entire kinetic energy appears as a X-ray photon

blocks.prompt:
15 What is attenuation of X-rays? Write the attenuation law and explain its terms. Explain contrast in X-ray images, the use of hard and soft X-rays and of contrast media, and the role of image intensifiers. (5 marks)
(X-rays ki attenuation kya hai? Attenuation ka qanoon likh kar us ki istilahat samjhayein. X-ray images mein contrast, hard aur soft X-rays aur contrast media ka istemaal, aur image intensifiers ka kirdar samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Attenuation: jism mein se guzarte hue X-rays atoms se interact kar ke energy khoti hain. X-rays atoms ko ionize karti hain yaani electrons nikaal deti hain; isi tarah energy muntaqil hoti hai. Is kami ko attenuation kehte hain.

Attenuation ka qanoon: material se guzarte hue beam ki intensity aahista aahista exponential andaz mein kam hoti hai:
I = I₀e^(−μx)
jahan I₀ = shuruaati intensity, I = material se guzarne ke baad intensity, x = material ki motai (metres mein), aur μ = attenuation coefficient jo material aur X-ray energy par munhasir hai. Motai x sirf exponent mein aati hai.

Contrast: X-ray images mein contrast ka matlab hai mukhtalif tissues ko kitni wazahat se alag pehchana ja sake; mukhtalif attenuation wale tissues tasweer par mukhtalif intensity dete hain. Contrast X-ray energy par munhasir hai:
• Hard X-rays (zyada energy) haddiyon ki imaging ke liye.
• Soft X-rays (kam energy) breast jaise naram tissues ke liye behtar.

Contrast media: iodine (Z = 53) ya barium (Z = 56) jaisi khaas cheezen jo X-rays achhi tarah jazb karti hain. Inhein injection ya nigal kar diya jata hai; zyada atomic number ki wajah se yeh X-ray absorption barha kar un hisson ko numayan karti hain.

Image intensifiers: foran X-ray imaging (fluoroscopy) mein; yeh tasweer roshan kar ke dekhna aasan karte hain aur radiation ka asar kam karne mein madad dete hain.

book_ref.quote: The intensity of the X-ray beam decreases gradually as it passes through a material.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein qanoon I = I₀ xe^(−μx) chhapa hai; durust shakal I = I₀e^(−μx) hai (book correction). x sirf exponent mein hai, bahar zarb nahin hota.

blocks.prompt:
16 An X-ray beam passes through a tissue of attenuation coefficient 60 m⁻¹. Using I = I₀e^(−μx), find (i) the fraction of the intensity that emerges from a 2.0 cm thickness (ii) the thickness that reduces the intensity to half. (3 marks)
(X-ray beam 60 m⁻¹ attenuation coefficient wale tissue se guzarti hai. I = I₀e^(−μx) se maloom karein (i) 2.0 cm motai se nikalne wali intensity ka hissa (ii) woh motai jo intensity ko aadha kar de.)
blocks.explanation: x ko metres mein I/I₀ = e^(−μx) mein rakhein; aadhi intensity ke liye e^(−μx) = 1/2, is liye x = ln 2/μ.

book_ref.quote: x = thickness of the material (in metres)

blocks.final_answer: (i) 0.30 (taqreeban 30%) nikalta hai (ii) taqreeban 1.2 cm motai intensity aadhi karti hai.

blocks.prompt:
17 What is computed tomography? Explain the limitation of an ordinary X-ray image and describe how a CT scanner produces cross-sectional and three-dimensional images. Explain the name Computed Axial Tomography and give the advantages and the main risk of CT. (5 marks)
(Computed tomography kya hai? Aam X-ray tasweer ki kami samjhayein aur bayan karein ke CT scanner cross-sectional aur teen-dimensional tasaveer kaise banata hai. Computed Axial Tomography ke naam ki wazahat karein aur CT ke fawaid aur asal khatra likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: computed tomography (CT) aik imaging technique hai jo X-ray technology aur computer processing ko mila kar jism ki andarooni banawat ki saaf cross-sectional aur 3D tasaveer banati hai. Yeh bimariyon ki tashkhees, andarooni chot ke pata aur ilaaj ki rehnumai mein kaam aati hai.

Aam X-ray ki kami: yeh chapti (2D) tasweer deti hai jis mein haddiyan aur aaza aik doosre par aa jate hain; maslan aage aur peeche ki pasliyan aik doosre ke ooper dikhti hain (Fig. 20.7).

Kaam: X-ray tube mareez ke gird ghoomti hai aur detectors apni jagah rehte hain, har taraf se maloomat jama hoti hai (Fig. 20.8). Aik hi hisse ki mukhtalif zawiyon se bohat si X-ray tasaveer li jati hain aur computer unhein jor kar aik tafseeli cross-sectional (slice) tasweer banata hai. Phir scanner jism ke saath thora aage barh kar agli slice ke liye amal dohrata hai. Aakhir mein computer tamam slices ko, cake ki tahon ki tarah, jor kar 3D tasweer banata hai (Fig. 20.9).

Naam: Computed: computer scan control karta, data process karta aur tasweer banata hai. Axial: scan jism ke axis ke saath liya jata hai. Tomography: Yunani tomos (slice) se, kyunke jism tah ba tah dekha jata hai.

Fawaid: CT aaza, haddiyon aur doosri cheezon ka size, shakal aur theek jagah teen dimensions mein dikhata hai aur bohat milti julti density wale tissues mein bhi farq karta hai; maslan tumor ki jagah aur size dikhata hai taa ke zyada energy ki X-rays ya gamma rays se theek nishana lagaya ja sake.

Khatra: CT mein X-rays (ionizing radiation) ka saamna hota hai jo thora khatra rakhti hain; khaas ehtiyat ki jati hai, khaas taur par haamla khawateen aur pehle se beemar mareezon ke liye.

book_ref.quote: An ordinary X-ray shows a flat (2D) image of the body

blocks.prompt:
18 In one projection of a CT scan, an X-ray beam crosses 3.0 cm of soft tissue (μ = 20 m⁻¹) along one path and 3.0 cm of bone (μ = 50 m⁻¹) along another. Using I = I₀e^(−μx), find the fraction of the intensity reaching the detector along each path and the ratio of the two intensities. (3 marks)
(CT scan ke aik projection mein X-ray beam aik raaste mein 3.0 cm naram tissue (μ = 20 m⁻¹) aur doosre raaste mein 3.0 cm haddi (μ = 50 m⁻¹) se guzarti hai. I = I₀e^(−μx) se har raaste par detector tak pahunchne wali intensity ka hissa aur dono intensities ki nisbat maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Har raasta I/I₀ = e^(−μx) ke mutabiq hai; dono detector readings ka farq hi computer ko tissues mein farq karne deta hai.

book_ref.quote: This makes it easier to distinguish between tissues, even when they have very similar densities.

blocks.final_answer: Naram tissue se taqreeban 55% aur haddi se 22% guzarta hai; naram tissue wala raasta taqreeban 2.5 guna zyada intensity deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
19 Explain the principle of nuclear medicine imaging and the SPECT technique. Describe the working of a PET scan, from the injection of the tracer to the formation of the image, and give its medical importance. (5 marks)
(Nuclear medicine imaging ka usool aur SPECT technique samjhayein. PET scan ka kaam, tracer ke injection se tasweer banne tak, bayan karein aur is ki tibbi ahmiyat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Usool: ionizing radiation wale imaging tareeqe radiation aur maadde ke interaction par mabni hain: tissue se guzarte photons absorb ya scatter hote hain aur energy ke jama hone aur attenuation ka pattern detector par signal deta hai. Nuclear medicine mein radiation mareez ke andar diye gaye radiopharmaceutical se aati hai, is liye signal sirf banawat nahin balke jism ka kaam (physiological function) dikhata hai.

SPECT: Single Photon Emission Computed Tomography mein gamma kharij karne wala tracer jism mein diya jata hai aur ghoomta gamma camera kai projection views record karta hai; in se tracer ki taqseem ki cross-sectional tasaveer banti hain jo perfusion aur organ ke kaam ki 3D maloomat deti hain.

PET (Fig. 20.10, 20.11): PET yahi khayal positron kharij karne wale tracers se aage barhata hai.
(i) Thori miqdaar mein radioactive tracer rag (vein) mein diya jata hai. Khoon use le jata hai aur yeh zyada sargarm tissues mein, maslan aksar cancers ya dimagh aur dil ke kaam karte hisson mein, zyada jama hota hai.
(ii) Tracer ke ghair mustahkam nuclei decay ho kar positrons kharij karte hain. Har positron thora faasla tay kar ke qareebi tissue ke electron se milta hai.
(iii) Positron aur electron annihilate hote hain; un ka mass do gamma-ray photons ki energy ban jata hai jo taqreeban mukhalif simton mein jate hain.
(iv) Mareez ke gird ring mein lage detectors in photon pairs ko coincidence mein detect karte hain, jis se har waqiye ki jagah maloom hoti hai, aur computer ko signals bhejte hain.
(v) Computer tracer uptake ka miqdaari naqsha banata hai. Roshan hisse zyada tracer aur zyada tissue sargarmi zahir karte hain.

Ahmiyat: PET non-invasive technique hai jo cellular/molecular satah par metabolic aur biochemical sargarmi dikhati hai; is liye cancer ki jaldi tashkhees aur staging, dimagh ke kaam ke jaize aur dil ki kharabiyon ki pehchan mein, banawat ki wazeh tabdeeli se pehle, bohat qeemti hai.

book_ref.quote: In nuclear medicine, the radiation originates inside the patient

blocks.prompt:
20 In a PET scan a positron and an electron, each of mass 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg, annihilate at rest and produce two gamma photons of equal energy. Find (i) the energy of each photon in joules and in MeV (ii) its frequency (iii) its wavelength (c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, 1 eV = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ J). (3 marks)
(PET scan mein aik positron aur aik electron, har aik ka mass 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg, sakoon mein annihilate ho kar barabar energy ke do gamma photons banate hain. Maloom karein (i) har photon ki energy joules aur MeV mein (ii) us ki frequency (iii) us ki wavelength (c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, 1 eV = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ J).)
blocks.explanation: Dono particles ka mass do barabar photons ki energy banta hai, is liye har photon aik particle ke mass ki energy mc² le jata hai.

book_ref.quote: When they meet, the positron and electron annihilate and their mass is converted into energy

blocks.final_answer: (i) 8.20 × 10⁻¹⁴ J ≈ 0.512 MeV (ii) 1.24 × 10²⁰ Hz (iii) 2.43 × 10⁻¹² m, yeh gamma ray hai.
